  <script type="text/javascript">
    (function(doc) {

      function setCookie(cname, cvalue, exdays) {
        const d = new Date();
        d.setTime(d.getTime() + (exdays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
        let expires = "expires=" + d.toUTCString();
        doc.cookie = cname + "=" + cvalue + ";" + expires + ";path=/";
      }

      function getCookie(cname) {
        let name = cname + "=";
        let decodedCookie = decodeURIComponent(doc.cookie);
        let ca = decodedCookie.split(';');
        for (let i = 0; i < ca.length; i++) {
          let c = ca[i];
          while (c.charAt(0) === ' ') {
            c = c.substring(1);
          }
          if (c.indexOf(name) === 0) {
            return c.substring(name.length, c.length);
          }
        }
        return "";
      }

      const HIDE_NEWSLETTER = 'hideNewsletter';
      const newsletterBanner = doc.querySelector('#mod-newsletter-banner');
      const closeButton = doc.querySelector('.o-NewsletterBanner__m-CloseButton');
      const days = 7;
      let shouldHideBanner = getCookie(HIDE_NEWSLETTER);

      if (shouldHideBanner && newsletterBanner && typeof newsletterBanner.style === 'object') {
        newsletterBanner.style.display = "none";
      } else if (closeButton && typeof closeButton.addEventListener === 'function') {
        closeButton.addEventListener('click', () => setCookie(HIDE_NEWSLETTER, true, days))
      }
      
    })(document)
  </script>

  <script type="text/javascript">
    (function(doc) {

      function setCookie(cname, cvalue, exdays) {
        const d = new Date();
        d.setTime(d.getTime() + (exdays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
        let expires = "expires=" + d.toUTCString();
        doc.cookie = cname + "=" + cvalue + ";" + expires + ";path=/";
      }

      function getCookie(cname) {
        let name = cname + "=";
        let decodedCookie = decodeURIComponent(doc.cookie);
        let ca = decodedCookie.split(';');
        for (let i = 0; i < ca.length; i++) {
          let c = ca[i];
          while (c.charAt(0) === ' ') {
            c = c.substring(1);
          }
          if (c.indexOf(name) === 0) {
            return c.substring(name.length, c.length);
          }
        }
        return "";
      }

      const HIDE_NEWSLETTER = 'hideNewsletter';
      const newsletterBanner = doc.querySelector('#mod-newsletter-banner');
      const closeButton = doc.querySelector('.o-NewsletterBanner__m-CloseButton');
      const days = 7;
      let shouldHideBanner = getCookie(HIDE_NEWSLETTER);

      if (shouldHideBanner && newsletterBanner && typeof newsletterBanner.style === 'object') {
        newsletterBanner.style.display = "none";
      } else if (closeButton && typeof closeButton.addEventListener === 'function') {
        closeButton.addEventListener('click', () => setCookie(HIDE_NEWSLETTER, true, days))
      }
      
    })(document)
  </script>

    (function(doc) {

      function setCookie(cname, cvalue, exdays) {
        const d = new Date();
        d.setTime(d.getTime() + (exdays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
        let expires = "expires=" + d.toUTCString();
        doc.cookie = cname + "=" + cvalue + ";" + expires + ";path=/";
      }

      function getCookie(cname) {
        let name = cname + "=";
        let decodedCookie = decodeURIComponent(doc.cookie);
        let ca = decodedCookie.split(';');
        for (let i = 0; i < ca.length; i++) {
          let c = ca[i];
          while (c.charAt(0) === ' ') {
            c = c.substring(1);
          }
          if (c.indexOf(name) === 0) {
            return c.substring(name.length, c.length);
          }
        }
        return "";
      }

      const HIDE_NEWSLETTER = 'hideNewsletter';
      const newsletterBanner = doc.querySelector('#mod-newsletter-banner');
      const closeButton = doc.querySelector('.o-NewsletterBanner__m-CloseButton');
      const days = 7;
      let shouldHideBanner = getCookie(HIDE_NEWSLETTER);

      if (shouldHideBanner && newsletterBanner && typeof newsletterBanner.style === 'object') {
        newsletterBanner.style.display = "none";
      } else if (closeButton && typeof closeButton.addEventListener === 'function') {
        closeButton.addEventListener('click', () => setCookie(HIDE_NEWSLETTER, true, days))
      }
      
    })(document)
  </script>

  <script type="text/javascript">
    (function(doc) {

      function setCookie(cname, cvalue, exdays) {
        const d = new Date();
        d.setTime(d.getTime() + (exdays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
        let expires = "expires=" + d.toUTCString();
        doc.cookie = cname + "=" + cvalue + ";" + expires + ";path=/";
      }

      function getCookie(cname) {
        let name = cname + "=";
        let decodedCookie = decodeURIComponent(doc.cookie);
        let ca = decodedCookie.split(';');
        for (let i = 0; i < ca.length; i++) {
          let c = ca[i];
          while (c.charAt(0) === ' ') {
            c = c.substring(1);
          }
          if (c.indexOf(name) === 0) {
            return c.substring(name.length, c.length);
          }
        }
        return "";
      }

      const HIDE_NEWSLETTER = 'hideNewsletter';
      const newsletterBanner = doc.querySelector('#mod-newsletter-banner');
      const closeButton = doc.querySelector('.o-NewsletterBanner__m-CloseButton');
      const days = 7;
      let shouldHideBanner = getCookie(HIDE_NEWSLETTER);

      if (shouldHideBanner && newsletterBanner && typeof newsletterBanner.style === 'object') {
        newsletterBanner.style.display = "none";
      } else if (closeButton && typeof closeButton.addEventListener === 'function') {
        closeButton.addEventListener('click', () => setCookie(HIDE_NEWSLETTER, true, days))
      }
      
    })(document)
  </script>

    (function(doc) {

      function setCookie(cname, cvalue, exdays) {
        const d = new Date();
        d.setTime(d.getTime() + (exdays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
        let expires = "expires=" + d.toUTCString();
        doc.cookie = cname + "=" + cvalue + ";" + expires + ";path=/";
      }

      function getCookie(cname) {
        let name = cname + "=";
        let decodedCookie = decodeURIComponent(doc.cookie);
        let ca = decodedCookie.split(';');
        for (let i = 0; i < ca.length; i++) {
          let c = ca[i];
          while (c.charAt(0) === ' ') {
            c = c.substring(1);
          }
          if (c.indexOf(name) === 0) {
            return c.substring(name.length, c.length);
          }
        }
        return "";
      }

      const HIDE_NEWSLETTER = 'hideNewsletter';
      const newsletterBanner = doc.querySelector('#mod-newsletter-banner');
      const closeButton = doc.querySelector('.o-NewsletterBanner__m-CloseButton');
      const days = 7;
      let shouldHideBanner = getCookie(HIDE_NEWSLETTER);

      if (shouldHideBanner && newsletterBanner && typeof newsletterBanner.style === 'object') {
        newsletterBanner.style.display = "none";
      } else if (closeButton && typeof closeButton.addEventListener === 'function') {
        closeButton.addEventListener('click', () => setCookie(HIDE_NEWSLETTER, true, days))
      }
      
    })(document)
